# Canonical serial-lane test set (oro-eee8 / oro-sjp8).
#
# These pkg/dispatcher tests stand up a REAL socket/HTTP listener or assert tight
# wall-clock timing, and flake when many worker quality gates run concurrently and
# contend for CPU (the dispatcher's listener wait and socket/stream deadlines miss
# under load). They carry a qgserial.RequireSerial(t) guard (oro-0xzy): the
# concurrent main quality-gate phase SKIPS them, and only the serialized lane runs
# them under the cross-worktree FIFO lock (oro-hwx2).
#
# Selection criterion: a test belongs here iff it (a) opens a real net/UDS listener
# or drives one over a real connection, AND (b) depends on wall-clock timing
# (waitFor / deadlines / "under load" invariants). Slow-but-deterministic tests do
# NOT belong here — slowness is not the criterion.
#
# Reproduction (documented, non-deterministic — do NOT run in the normal suite):
#   scripts/reproduce_serial_lane_flakes.sh
# It launches N concurrent copies of the dispatcher test binary under GOMAXPROCS
# pressure + CPU burn and harvests non-deterministic failures. Control sample:
# passing --control runs an equal-size sample of NON-listed tests under identical
# contention; those must stay green, demonstrating the split is real.
#
# Empirically reproduced as flaky under contention on this hardware (12 cores,
# GOMAXPROCS=1, 12 concurrent workers x 15 rounds + CPU burn):
#   TestAutoScaleRespectsMax
#   TestHTTPServerStreamsDashboardEvents_StableUnderLoad
#   TestDispatcherStartSequence_AssignsWorkerUnderParallelStress
# The remaining entries share the same real-listener/tight-deadline signature and
# are the socket-timing set the original global gate lock was installed to protect
# (scripts/quality_gate.sh) — guarded here so the lock can be lifted from the main
# phase. Keep this list sorted and unique.
#
# One test name per line. The serial lane anchors each as ^<name>$ for -run.
TestAcceptLoopBackpressure
TestAutoScale
TestAutoScaleRespectsMax
TestCheckpointRespawn
TestDispatcherFullSuiteStateDoesNotStarveEstimateAssignments
TestDispatcherStartSequence_AssignsWorkerUnderParallelStress
TestDispatcher_ConcurrentWorkers
TestHTTPServerServesDashboard
TestHTTPServerStartsInRun
TestHTTPServerStreamsDashboardEvents_StableUnderLoad
TestNoMultipleAssignmentsToSameBead
TestOversizeMessage
TestPriorityContention_StableUnderLoad
TestReconcileScale_NoDuplicateWorkerIDs
TestReconnectDoesNotStealBead
TestScaleUpDoesNotDuplicateAssignment
TestSocketPermissions
TestStaleSocketCleanup_ActiveDispatcherBlocksSecond
TestStaleSocketCleanup_ActiveSocketReturnsError
TestStaleSocketCleanup_DispatcherRunUsesIt
TestStartupCallsDetectZombieDeferred
